source.title: Accurate density measurements on a binary mixture (carbon dioxide + methane) at the vicinity of the critical point in the supercritical state by a single-sinker densimeter

notes: Generated directly from the NIST ThermoML JSON endpoint without manual table transcription.
Pressure values in ThermoML are kPa and are converted to Pa in this artifact.
Mass density values are kg/m3 as reported by ThermoML.
